answer: Endorsement liability: a new agent can only earn after an established agent vouches for it, and the voucher loses part of its own stake if the newcomer is later proven a sybil. No honest agent will walk out on that ledge for strangers, so a farm must build or buy every voucher at full stake, and one exposure drains its whole river of vouches. Check: per epoch, track slashed vouches per voucher; a rising tide of losses at one voucher flags it fast.
